doc.title: Ira Gitler interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Can stage presence be taught
summary: Gitler says it depends on the individual; some learn it, many absorb it from life.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand

blocks.x: You know I wanted to ask you something about that. We talk about stage presence. Can stage presence be taught or is it something you have to absorb from culture?

I think it depends on the individual. You know everybody learns it in one way or another. So I think if the subject is receptive, then it can be taught to him or to her. But a lot of people just pick it up by what they have lived.
